**Image 1 (Home Page):**
Yes, the UI is properly dark. The sidebar is a dark charcoal/navy, the main content area is black, and all cards (hero, stats, "Continue Creating," and "Recent Moments") use dark backgrounds with light text. There are no light-mode leftovers or white elements that should be dark. The contrast between the white text and dark backgrounds is excellent.

**Image 2 (Notifications Sheet):**
Yes, the notifications sheet is a centered floating dark card with rounded corners. It sits on top of a blurred/dimmed version of the home page. The sheet's background is dark gray/black with light-colored text, maintaining the dark mode theme perfectly. There are no light-mode leftovers or contrast problems; all text is clearly readable against the dark background.
